definitions.gloss: the Allies; the Allied Powers (in the World Wars)
definitions.explanation: The countries that fought together against Germany, Japan and their partners in the Second World War (and against the Central Powers in the First). Japan was occupied by the Allied Powers from 1945 to 1952.

definitions.gloss: allied nations; a coalition of countries
definitions.explanation: Countries joined in an alliance in general.

examples.japanese: {連合国|れんごうこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。

notes:
The English name of the United Nations is translated ⟦{国際連合|こくさいれんごう}→国際連合：18107_kokusairengou⟧ (⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧), which comes from the same wartime alliance; in Japanese, {連合国|れんごうこく} on its own means the wartime Allies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連合国軍|れんごうこくぐん}: the Allied forces
- {連合国軍総司令部|れんごうこくぐんそうしれいぶ}: GHQ, the Allied occupation headquarters in Japan
- {連合国|れんごうこく}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the Allied side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {枢軸国|すうじくこく}: the Axis Powers — the other side
- ⟦{同盟国|どうめいこく}→同盟国：22005_doumeikoku⟧: an ally, a country bound by treaty
